approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the complete terminal-run workflow index to bound one exact RFI or Submittal or one selected Email.
Accept only explicit Action Required, Required Action, Next Action or Action Item labels in the correct workflow or current Email-body scope.
Apply the same identity, role and complete-value contract to ordinary answers and comparison source findings.
Fail closed on missing fields, conflicts, cross-scope borrowing, headers, quoted history, signatures, ordinary prose, vision narration and oversized source sets.
Do not infer applicability, responsibility, approval, chronology, authority or action ownership.
title: Answer and ground exact workflow and Email action fields
objective: Return bounded exact workflow and Email action fields without provider cost and reject unsupported identity, role, value or source-scope borrowing in every answer scope.
